name: Furrydelphia
blurb: Philadelphia's furry fandom convention: a charity-focused weekend of panels, art and community each August at the Sheraton Downtown Philadelphia.

editions.evidence: Homepage banner text: 'August 5-8, 2027'; page title 'Furrydelphia 2027: In Debt to a Raccoon'; text: 'Join us at the Sheraton Downtown Philadelphia Philadelphia, PA'.

notes: Furrydelphia, Inc. is a 501(c)(3) running an annual 3-day (Thu-Sun) furry convention in Philadelphia. The 2027 theme is 'In Debt to a Raccoon', Aug 5-8, 2027, at the Sheraton Downtown Philadelphia (201 North 17th Street). No Guest of Honor, ticket price or guest page has been announced yet (confirmed via web search: 'the 2027 ticket price, charity, and Guest of Honor have not been published'), so guests is 'none-yet'. The homepage 'About' page lists photos of people, but they are the convention's Board of Directors/staff (Chairman, Vice-Chairman, etc.), not guests, so they were skipped per the research rules. Nav items Home/About/Applications/Convention are client-side routed with no crawlable hrefs besides Hotel, so only Home and About could be checked directly.
